request.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Standalone Kalistar fantasy character painting, vertical 4:5, not a card. Depict ADULT brother Nier from NieR Replicant after the time skip. Reference1 establishes costume and identity: use the ADULT upper figure ONLY, silver hair in a short tied-back ponytail, lean strong adult face, dark grey leather tunic, black fur collar and cuffs, worn embroidered guards, pale fur waist wrap and dark boots. Do not depict the child or copy the reference pose or drawing style. Reference2 Momo defines visible painterly strokes and textured color planes; reference3 Kaylis defines natural painted faces and narrative emotion. Scene: he is climbing the ruined broad stone steps of the Lost Shrine, turns in protective determination with one hand raised toward Grimoire Weiss hovering at chest height. Weiss is the main magical weapon: thick ivory-bound closed tome angled in perspective, embossed silver human-face relief unmistakably visible on the cover, heavy metal corners and a coherent page block held inside the binding. A few restrained dark crimson magical sealed-word wisps orbit the book, not legible writing; Nier's sword remains sheathed and secondary. His eyes show stubborn tenderness and exhaustion, driven to rescue Yonah, not a blank handsome portrait. Wind pulls his ponytail and cloak scraps. Moss on stone steps, monumental sanctuary arch behind and a calm patch of pale sky, avoid dense decorative clutter. Full figure or knees up with ample room around head and hands, main face and book within central60%width. Realistic proportions painted with bold brush marks, tactile worn cloth/leather/stone, expressive grounded emotion, motivated cold daylight and warm book glow. No anime/manga faces, photorealism or CGI smoothness. Exactly one person, two hands, one floating book. No typography, watermark, logos, UI or card borders.

review: Reviewed adult identity, one continuous closed tome with embossed face and page block; magical book distinct from sheathed sword. Card crop must preserve upper-right book.
